headline_marked: BNP denies [[ear-biting allegation against leader]] in Narsingdi
headline: BNP denies ear-biting allegation against leader in Narsingdi
summary: The Ghorashal Municipal BNP has called the claims of a leader biting a businessman's ear during an assaulty 'false' and a political conspiracy.
details: The Ghorashal Municipal BNP held a press conference on Saturday to deny allegations that one of its leaders, Mohiuddin Chishtia, bit the ear of sand businessman Sakhawat Hossain during an abduction and assault.

According to the complainant, Mia Mohammad Sajib, Sakhawat was abducted on Monday evening from Ghorashal and taken to Chishtia's house, where he was beaten and had his ear bitten, requiring four stitches at a health complex.

The BNP leadership claimed the allegation is a fabrication designed to frame Chishtia, arguing that in the digital age, criminals use weapons rather than biting ears, and that the case is politically motivated.

Adding to the tension, the office of the complainant, Mia Mohammad Sajib, was set on fire early Saturday morning. The fire destroyed over 100 books, furniture, and photos of BNP leaders, and killed 15 pet birds.

Sajib, who is the district vice president of Chhatra Dal, describes the same-time threats he has received from Mohiuddin Chishtia since filing the case, claiming he was not targeted even during the previous government's tenure.
Police from the Palashes Upazila have stated that they will take legal action against those involved in the arson attack once a written complaint is filed.
The original complaint alleges that the abduction occurred after the suspects demanded 2 million BDT in extortion money from Sakhawat Hossain while he was working on a project.

headline_marked: NCP leader [[attacked in Netrokona]] ahead of ‘July march’
headline: NCP leader attacked in Netrokona ahead of ‘July march’
summary: Mushfiqur Rahman, a senior member of the National Citizen Party, was assaulted with sticks at a hotel in Khaliajuri while preparing for an upcoming party event.
details: Mushfiqur Rahman, senior member secretary of the National Citizen Party (NCP) Netrokona district committee, was allegedly attacked in Khaliajuri on Monday afternoon.
The incident took place at a food hotel near College Field, where Rahman and other party leaders had gone to inspect a potential venue for the upcoming 'July March' program.
According to reports, a group of young men first entered the hotel and verbally abused Rahman. After a brief confrontation, they left, only to return through the back door later.
The attackers then assaulted Rahman with sticks and other local weapons, causing injuries to his hand, neck, eye, and other parts of his body.
Rahman was rescued by those present and taken to the upazila health complex for medical treatment.
The NCP's 'July March' is scheduled for July 24 in Netrokona Sadar and Khaliajuri, with Chief Coordinator Nasir Uddin Patwary and Chief Organiser (North) Sarjis Alam expected to attend.
Khaliajuri Police Station OC Md Nasir Uddin stated that police have visited the site and will take legal action once a formal complaint is filed.
